_: Category-based semantic-search eval — 20 queries over the 20 landmark Iowa
cases in caselaw_eval_queries.json, supplied to test the production retrieval
pipeline (bi-encoder recall -> cross-encoder rerank) under four query styles:
A  Pure fact-pattern / narrative  (messy real-world scenario -> holding)
B  Abstract legal concept         (formal jargon, no narrative overlap)
C  Fragmentary / citation / name  (short token distributions)
D  Adversarial / hard-rerank      (shared keywords, different rule)
'area' carries the testing CATEGORY so the eval_caselaw by-area report becomes
a per-category breakdown. 'legal_area', 'category', and 'distractor' are extra
fields the harness ignores; 'distractor' names the case that MUST be outranked.
target_cluster values were verified against the DB (case_name + reporter
citations in source_metadata) on 2026-06-07 — all 20 loaded, chunked, embedded.
